messages:
matt: Heads-up — customer reported project quota being charged to the org instead of the downstream service account. Traced it to the auth proxy losing origin project on token-exchange path.

sara: Oof. Is that the SA -> token-exchange -> gateway flow? Any traces or example headers?

matt: Yep. Example from trace (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer ya29...
X-Service-Account: sa-abc
# We used to rely on token.claims.project but the exchange path sometimes returns org-scoped tokens
```
My quick workaround idea: add an explicit X-Origin-Attribution header during exchange that looks like:
```
X-Origin-Attribution: origin=project:proj-123;actor=sa:svc-abc
```
and sign it:
```
X-Origin-Signature: sha256=...
```
so downstream gateways can trust it.

kai: We've discussed header vs token-claim before. Token claim is nicer (atomic) but needs changes to token minting and rotation + client reissuance. Header is faster to ship but is spoofable unless verified. Signing via exchange service (HMAC) is reasonable; gateway should verify signature with a rotating key.

emily: From telemetry/console POV: we should run this in shadow mode first and collect: attributed_by_header vs attributed_by_claim, and a flag for signature_verified. Dashboards: add a breakdown for attribution_source (claim/header/inferred/missing) and attribution_mismatch_rate. We need to capture cases where header exists but signature fails.

product-lead: Migration/rollout proposal: 1) shadow signing on all traffic (no quota enforcement) for 2 weeks, 2) enable signed-header attribution for a tiny canary (5% orgs) with quota enforcement, 3) observe for 1 week, 4) 25% canary, then 100%. Document opt-out path.

matt: Implementation plan: exchange service adds origin header + X-Origin-Signature during token exchange when it knows the original project. Auth proxy verifies signature and sets request.attribution before quota check. Console will show 'signed_origin' boolean per request in logs. I'll open a PR.

kai: Also add audit logs including token_id, signer_key_id, verification_result. Metrics: attribution_verified_total, attribution_failed_total, attribution_mismatch_total (header vs claim). Tag metrics by org and project so we can roll back by org.

ops: @deploy-bot can we canary the proxy change to 5% with a feature flag? Need a revert plan and alert for attribution_mismatch spike.

deploy-bot: matt started canary deploy: eng-platform-proxy v1.2.3 -> canary group (5%). Logs/links: https://ci/internal/deploys/6162626262 (internal) :rocket:

emily: Also add a short migration playbook in the PR: how support will flip flag per-org, check dashboards, and revert. Include SLA notes: until canary is stable, don't enforce hard quota alerts to sales ops.

sara: Sounds good — I'll add the rollout checklist to the PR and coordinate with support on the communication. :thumbsup:

matt: I'll post the PR link once ready. Thanks all — shadow mode first, then slow canary. :eyes:
